 By  CALVIN STEVENS CALVIN STEVENS - Sports Editor
 Fri,11/13/26-10:40AM,  1,024 Reads 
 One of the main positives for Mississippi Valley State University coming out of last weekend’s 38-7 loss at Jackson State University was being penalized only four times.
Head coach Terrell Buckley is hoping that continues Saturday, as the Delta Devils play at Florida A&M in Tallahassee.
“We have truly been working on that since we’ve been getting penalized so much this season,”…

 Support local news with a year-end gift
 Local news matters to Greenwood. It keeps neighbors informed and connected. It asks the questions people want answered. It celebrates what’s good and exposes what’s not. 
 Doing that well takes skilled reporters and editors, as many as our community can support through advertising, subscriptions and philanthropy.
 In 2025, The Greenwood Commonwealth added Gerard Edic to our newsroom as a reporter covering public safety and other stories that matter to our community. Since then, our readers have followed the transfer of Greenwood Leflore Hospital to UMMC and the toll of gun violence in our neighborhoods, with more reporting than we could have done without him.
 Report for America, a national nonprofit, funds part of Gerard’s position through a two-year grant. We raise the rest from local donors.
 This year, our goal is $37,800. Generous supporters have already given or pledged more than $30,000, which leaves us less than $7,800 to go.
 Will you help us finish the job with a tax-deductible year-end gift?
